[[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]'' Toydaria{{TCW|Witches of the Mist}} |species=[[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] |gender=[[Gender/Legends|Male]] |pronouns=He/him |height=1.52 [[Meter/Legends|meters]]''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia]]'' |mass= |hair=[[Color/Legends|Black]]{{TCW|Ambush}} |feathers= |eyes=Brown |skin=Pale green |cyber= |families= |parents= |partners= |siblings= |children= |affiliation=*[[Toydarian royal delegation/Legends|Toydarian royal delegation]] *[[Toydarian ministry council]]{{TCW|Supply Lines}} *[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] **[[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]{{TCW|Senate Murders}} |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Quote|You have my faith. Toydaria would be honored to host a Republic base. My people are at your service.|Katuunko, to Jedi Master Yoda|audio=Katuunko1.flac|}} '''Katuunko''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] who ruled as the [[King/Legends|king]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Toydaria/Legends|Toydaria]] in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Katuunko was approached by [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]] and [[Junior Representative/Legends|Representative]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during their mission to deliver relief supplies to the [[Battle of Ryloth (disambiguation)|contested]] world of [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Although Katuunko wished to help the planet's starving [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] population, he was unable to formally support a Republic intervention force due to his planet's reliance on the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], a corporation with ties to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. In an effort to both aid the Twi'leks and maintain the facade of neutrality, Katuunko allowed for relief supplies to be covertly shuttled to Ryloth via Toydaria. As Federation officials had no evidence of the king's complicity in the operation, Toydaria was allowed to remain neutral, but Katuunko decided that it was time for his people to ally themselves with one of the warring factions, so that his planet might be safe from other threats. He was soon contacted by the Republic's [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], who requested that the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] be permitted to use Toydaria as a supply base and staging ground in their war against the Confederacy. Katuunko proposed that negotiations between himself and a Republic envoy take place on [[Rugosa/Legends|Rugosa]], a neutral [[Moon/Legends|moon]] near Toydaria. On Rugosa, Katuunko and the [[Toydarian royal delegation/Legends|Toydarian royal delegation]] were greeted not by a Republic representative, but instead by [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] of the Confederacy. While Ventress proposed an alliance between the king and the Confederacy, the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order's]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] and several [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] arrived at Rugosa but were forced to land on the moon in an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] after their [[Consular-class cruiser (Charger c70 retrofit)/Legends|ship]] was attacked by [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|Confederate frigates]]. Although Ventress claimed the attack was proof of the Confederacy's superiority, Katuunko still wished to meet with Yoda, and so agreed to a [[Battle of Rugosa/Legends|challenge]] set forth by Ventress. If her [[Troop/Legends|troops]] were able to capture Yoda before he could reach the king, Toydaria would join the Confederacy; however, if Yoda managed to evade Ventress and her [[Droid/Legends|droids]], the king would pledge his alliance to the Republic. While Yoda and his small force of [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] troopers trekked across the coral moon of Rugosa, Katuunko became increasingly disturbed with Ventress's tactics and dishonesty, and eventually rejected the Confederacy's offer. Yoda and the troopers arrived just in time to prevent the Dark Acolyte from [[Assassin/Legends|assassinating]] the king, which led the grateful Katuunko to promised his unwavering service to the Republic. Confederate [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] held Katuunko in contempt for his decision to support the Jedi, and so dispatched his new [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]], to Toydaria to [[Showdown at Toydaria/Legends|capture]] the king alive shortly after the [[Battle of Sullust/Legends|Battle of Sullust]]. However, Opress disobeyed his [[Sith Master/Legends|Master]] and instead [[Death/Legends|killed]] Katuunko by crushing his throat when the Toydarian king attempted to escape. When Dooku discovered this, he was extremely furious with Opress. ==Biography== ===A question of allegiance=== {{Quote|Perhaps you failed to pay attention to the Senate orientation. They should have explained that Toydaria is a neutral system. We are ''not'' part of the Republic.|King Katuunko|}} Katuunko was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] who served as [[King/Legends|king]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Toydaria/Legends|Toydaria]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy-wide]] conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' the Republic was able to broker a [[Hutt–Republic treaty/Legends|treaty]] with the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]], which would permit Republic forces to travel freely through [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]],[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' novelization]] a region that incorporated Toydaria.''[[The Clone Wars: Prelude]]'' Although he was officially subservient to Hutt interests, Katuunko preferred to keep an independent mind in matters he could control. As such, he remained skeptical of the Republic's intentions in Hutt Space, as Toydaria was a strategically valuable world to both the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] and the Confederacy's [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Droid Army]] due to the fact that the world rested along major space lanes. However, this placement also put Toydaria under constant danger from [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] attacks from which the King sought protection, and Katuunko conceded that he would need to ally with one of the two warring factions. His plan was impeded by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], a pan-galactic megacorporation that Toydaria relied upon for commerce services. Although the Federation was a well-known affiliate of the Confederacy, the corporation's officials continued to claim that their goods were being utilized by the Separatist movement without authorization, and that they, like the Toydarian government, were a neutral institution in the conflict. ====Torn between neutrality and morality==== [[File:KatuunkoPresiding-SL.png|thumb|right|250px|Katuunko presides over the Organa-Dod debate.]] {{Quote|Your treaty with the Hutts may make you a guest in these parts, but we still remain neutral in ''your'' war.''"
"''Neutrality may be a luxury you cannot afford, King.|Katuunko and Supreme Chancellor Palpatine|}} Later that year, Toydaria was visited by two members of the Republic's [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]—[[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] and [[Junior Representative/Legends|Associate Planetary Representative]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Both worlds had a long history of charitable endeavors and humanitarian causes, and the two [[Politics/Legends|politicians]] were now focusing their efforts on aiding the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] population of [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] planet [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]], which was [[Battle of Ryloth (disambiguation)|suffering]] from severe starvation and a lack of medical supplies due to a Confederate [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of the world. They had been encouraged by the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|High Council]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] to seek aid from the government of Toydaria, as Katuunko's world was not far from Ryloth. The king welcomed the two visitors to his [[Toydarian palace/Legends|palace]] in a formal gathering of his [[Toydarian ministry council|ministry council]], but chided Organa and Binks for requesting assistance from Toydaria, as the world was not part of the Republic. However, as they explained the urgency of the situation to him, Katuunko and his ministers became open to the idea of providing aid to the Twi'lek people. Organa and Binks's progress was derailed by the sudden arrival of [[Lott Dod/Legends|Lott Dod]], the senatorial representative of the Trade Federation and a secret backer of the Confederate cause. Dod had received word that Republic representatives would make an attempt to persuade Katuunko to provide relief to Ryloth, and so traveled to the Toydarian homeworld to intimidate the king. Upon his arrival, Katuunko granted him an audience alongside Organa and Binks and proceeded to hear his argument that Toydaria's interference with a Confederate blockade would force the Federation to cease business with the world. As Organa had as of yet neglected to mention the blockade, Katuunko was forced to rescind his earlier offer of assistance and convene his ministers to hear a [[The Matter of Using Toydarian Territory to Aid the Shipment of Relief Supplies to the Citizens of Ryloth/Legends|formal debate]] between Dod and Organa over the matter. Once the senators had prepared their arguments, Katuunko called the debate to order and allowed Organa to make his case. The [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] explained that the mission to Ryloth was purely humanitarian and that the Republic had no interest in bringing Toydaria into conflict with the Confederacy. He supplemented his claims by presenting to the ministry council a transmission from the Senator of Ryloth, [[Orn Free Taa/Legends|Orn Free Taa]], who explained the ruin that had befallen his home planet and the crisis now faced by his people. While [[Constitutionalist Toydarian minister|one of]] the king's ministers was convinced of the need to help Ryloth, [[Neutralist Toydarian minister|another]] cautioned that their compassion must not be allowed to draw Toydaria into the war. Katuunko then allowed Dod to present his argument, which the senator did by accusing Organa of deceit and providing images of the battle on Ryloth's surface between the Republic's [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] and the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] of the Confederacy. Furthermore, Dod argued that the [[Separatist Senate/Legends|Separatist Senate]] would see it as an overt violation of Toydaria's supposed neutrality, which would lead Trade Federation [[Starship/Legends|vessels]] working with Toydaria to become targets for Separatist attacks. Although Organa attempted to make one final argument on behalf of the Twi'leks, it was ultimately in vain. Katuunko was forced to reject the senator's request for aid in the interest of protecting his people, but found himself regretting the decision due to his people's noble values. After announcing his choice before his ministers and the senators, Katuunko left his hearing chamber to catch Senator Organa before he and Binks left Toydaria. The king conceded that he could not, in good conscience, leave the Twi'leks to suffer, and so informed them that he would allow for the Republic to use Toydaria to make a covert transfer of the supplies Organa had brought with him. Although the Alderaanian was disappointed that Katuunko would not allow for more relief supplies to be brought in, he accepted the offer and promised that he would prevent the Federation from learning of Katuunko's complicity in the mercy mission. To that end, Organa arranged for a state dinner to take place so that Senator Dod would be distracted from the Republic [[Pelta-class frigate/Legends|''Pelta''-class blockade runners]] departing from Katuunko's palace. While the Alderaanian led the effort to load the supplies onto the ships, Representative Binks remained with Katuunko and Dod and created a conceptual art piece to keep the dinner's attendees attention. The gambit was successful, and although Dod accused Katuunko of having helped the Republic after hearing the Twi'leks had received supplies from Republic ships, he had no evidence to support the claim. Because of his favorable experience in working with Organa and Binks, Katuunko informed the two that he would be open to allegiance negotiations with the Republic. [[File:Katuunko_palpatine.png|thumb|left|280px|Katuunko in communication with [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]]] Sometime after the Ryloth matter, Katuunko was contacted by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] of the Galactic Republic while traveling in his personal [[Yacht/Legends|star yacht]], the [[Thief's Eye/Legends|''Thief's Eye'']]. The Chancellor informed Katuunko that the Republic had need of Toydaria, and wished to use the planet as a staging ground for the war effort. Although he preferred not to join the Confederacy, the king, a potentially important Republic ally in the war,''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Incredible Vehicles]]'' was still unwilling to throw support blindly to the Republic, and so proposed a diplomatic rendezvous for negotiations to the Chancellor, under the condition that Toydaria would not be strong-armed into an agreement under threat of force. The Chancellor agreed; however, Katuunko had one additional request: the Republic emissary was to be a member of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], as the king had always been interested in meeting a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. Palpatine did not want to dispatch a Jedi to Toydaria, as the world was close to Confederate space. Katuunko used a [[Chance cube/Legends|chance cube]] to select [[Rugosa/Legends|Rugosa]], a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] near Toydaria, as the site of the negotiations. Palpatine agreed to the king's conditions, and [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] of the Jedi Order was dispatched to serve as the Republic's ambassador. Unbeknownst to both Katuunko and Palpatine, their communication had been intercepted by the Confederacy's newly constructed [[Skytop Station/Legends|Skytop Station]], a listening outpost in the [[Ruusan system/Legends|Hoth's Brand system]]. [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], the Confederacy's [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]], hoped to make Toydaria an ally of the Confederacy, and so dispatched his apprentice, the [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], to initiate negotiations on his behalf. ====Negotiations on Rugosa==== {{Main|Mission to Rugosa}} {{Dialogue|Yoda|Unaware I was, Count Dooku was invited to our meeting.|Katuunko|The Count invited himself. He assures me that in this time of war, his droids can offer my world greater security than your Jedi.|Yoda|Hmm…a matter of debate that is.|Ventress|Your Majesty might prefer more than words.|attr=Yoda, Katuunko, and Asajj Ventress shortly after arriving on Rugosa|audio=Katuunko2.flac|src=}} [[File:Ventress_Katuunko.png|thumb|right|280px|Katuunko receives offers for an alliance from both the Republic and the Confederacy.]] As the ''Thief's Eye'' arrived on Rugosa, Katuunko and two of his guards were greeted by Asajj Ventress and a pair of [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]]. Ventress presented the [[Toydarian royal delegation/Legends|Toydarian royal delegation]] with a communication from Count Dooku himself, who claimed the Jedi were incapable of protecting themselves and therefore would be unable to protect Toydaria. To reinforce his point, the Count laid a trap for the Republic [[Consular-class cruiser (Charger c70 retrofit)/Legends|diplomatic cruiser]], which had arrived in orbit moments before. The cruiser, which carried Jedi Master Yoda and a small contingent of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] for security, came under heavy fire from two [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|Confederate frigates]]. The Republic vessel was forced to retreat; however, Master Yoda refused to abandon his mission, and boarded an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] along with the clone troopers [[Thire/Legends|Thire]], [[Jek/Legends|Jek]], and [[Rys/Legends|Rys]]. The pod was launched to the moon's surface shortly before the cruiser made its escape.{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode001.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Ambush}} On Rugosa's surface, Katuunko debated with the Count over the abilities of the Jedi and the droid army. After Dooku ceased his communication, the king witnessed the Republic cruiser retreat into hyperspace, and it was assumed the Jedi had abandoned the negotiations. Ventress hoped the retreat would seal Toydaria's fate as a Confederate world; however, she was interrupted by a communication from Master Yoda, whose escape pod had just landed not far from the king, in the [[Rugosa land coral|coral forests]] that covered most of Rugosa. As King Katuunko informed Yoda of Dooku's proposal, Asajj Ventress suggested that Toydaria's alliance be decided by a challenge of Yoda's skill. She proposed that she would send her best droid [[Troop/Legends|troops]] to capture the Jedi Master; if Yoda managed to escape, Toydaria would join the Republic. However, if Yoda was defeated, Katuunko would consider an alliance with the Confederacy. The king protested the contest, as he did not request the Jedi's presence for him to fight; however, the Grand Master agreed to the terms before ending his communication. The king insisted on a term of his own to Ventress— Yoda was to be given a fair fight. Ventress agreed, however she had no intention of keeping her word, as a [[C-9979 landing craft/Legends|C-9979 troop ship]] soon landed and began deploying a full battalion of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] and [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tanks]] tasked with hunting down the Jedi Master. King Katuunko remained alongside Ventress and monitored the Jedi's progress through his [[Rangefinder/Legends|rangefinder]] as the droids chased Yoda and the clones through the coral forests. Ventress received regular updates on the mission from her [[OOM command battle droid/Legends|droid commander]], [[224/Legends|224]], while Master Yoda would periodically contact the king. Katuunko repeatedly debated with Ventress on the likelihood of Yoda's success, angering her until she eventually destroyed his [[Imagecaster/Legends|communicator]] with her bare hand. During their trek to the rendezvous point, Yoda and his clones seemingly became trapped after entering a canyon while followed by a column of droids and tanks. Yoda revealed himself to the droids, who surrounded the Jedi and contacted Ventress for orders on how to proceed. Instead of capturing the surrendered Jedi Master, Ventress ordered that he be fired upon. Katuunko witnessed the ensuing skirmish from afar, commenting that Master Yoda's surrender was generating an unusual amount of smoke. After Ventress learned of 224's destruction at Yoda's hand, the king claimed that all rumors about the power of the Jedi were true, provoking the Dark Acolyte to break the terms of the competition and order [[Droideka/Legends|droidekas]] to enter the battle. =====Assassination attempt===== {{Quote|Perhaps our negotiations will be more fruitful with your successor. Ventress, kill him!|Count Dooku, ordering Katuunko's assassination|audio=Katuunko3.flac|}} [[File:Ventress_strikes.png|thumb|left|280px|Katuunko, saved from assassination at the hands of Asajj Ventress]] Despite Ventress's efforts, Yoda and the clones were able to destroy all of the droids and continue their journey. King Katuunko, fully convinced that the contest was over, contacted Count Dooku to inform him that his allegiance would be given to the Republic. Although Dooku urged the king to reconsider, Katuunko was adamant in his support of the Republic, and claimed he would not deal with those who broke their word, as Ventress had when she broke the terms of the competition by attempting to overwhelm Yoda with the droidekas. Dooku decided that negotiations with Katuunko's successor would be more productive, and ordered his apprentice to kill the Toydarian. Both royal guards moved to defend their king, but Ventress deflected their blasterfire and [[Telekinesis/Legends|Force-pushed]] them away before moving to kill the king with her [[Interlocking hilt|paired lightsabers]]; Katuunko closed his eyes as she swung, then opened them to see why he wasn't dead : Ventress had been stopped mid-strike by Master Yoda, who had arrived just in time to [[Telekinesis/Legends#Force Disarm|telekinetically]] halt her attack with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. After Ventress was disarmed and her droid escorts were destroyed by Yoda's clone troopers, Yoda encouraged her to surrender. However, Dooku's minion had no intention of being captured by the Republic, and detonated explosives she had planted on a hill beside Katuunko, causing a landslide and also damaging his star yacht. While Master Yoda used the Force to halt the falling rocks and save the lives of his clones and the king, Ventress escaped Rugosa on her [[Punworcca 116-class interstellar sloop/Legends|solar sailer]]. With the Confederacy no longer on Rugosa, Master Yoda hoped to begin negotiations with King Katuunko. However, Katuunko claimed negotiations were unnecessary, as Master Yoda had proven himself and the Republic worthy of Toydaria's faith. The king unsheathed a [[Ceremonial sword/Legends|ceremonial Toydarian sword]] and presented it to Yoda, entrusting the protection of his planet to the Jedi{{TCW|Ambush|d=y}} and proclaiming the Toydarian people to be at the service of the Republic. Shortly after, Katuunko was ferried up to a Republic [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] in an [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i gunship]] alongside Yoda, the clones, and the Toydarian guards. Katuunko would later have the ''Thief's Eye'' recovered and repaired afterwards. ===The price of loyalty=== {{Quote|You ignorant beast! I told you, I wanted him alive!|Count Dooku, enraged with Savage Opress for killing Katuunko|audio=YouIgnorantBeast-WotM.flac|}} As a Republic member world around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], Toydaria was granted representation in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]. Katuunko was part of the Toydarian senatorial delegation when [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Halle Burtoni/Legends|Halle Burtoni]] of [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] proposed that the Senate approve [[Republic military enhancement bill/Legends|legislation]] that would increase the production of clone troops. Although Burtoni's proposal was widely supported,{{TCW|Pursuit of Peace}} an opposition faction organized by Senators [[Onaconda Farr/Legends|Onaconda Farr]] and [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] introduced a [[Reduced military spending bill/Legends|bill]] to the Senate that would decrease military spending within the Republic and halt the production of clone troopers. Senator Amidala herself took to the Senate floor twice, once to attack Burtoni's bill and once more to appeal to her colleagues for more votes in support of her and Farr's. Katuunko was present in the Senate's [[Grand Convocation Chamber]] as Amidala made her addresses, which were both met with much praise. In the following days, the Senate was wracked by intrigue with the [[Death/Legends|deaths]] of Senator Farr and [[Umbaran/Legends|Umbaran]] Senator [[Mee Deechi/Legends|Mee Deechi]]. Despite the strange turn of events, the vote on the bill proceeded, and Amidala's and Farr's resolution was turned down. [[File:KatuunkoChoked-WOTM.png|thumb|right|270px|Katuunko is choked to death during his escape attempt.]] The king was once again holding court within his palace on Toydaria shortly after the [[Battle of Sullust/Legends|Battle of Sullust]]. Around this time, Asajj Ventress was betrayed by Dooku and replaced with a new [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Nightbrothers/Legends|Nightbrother]] [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]]. The Count still held a grudge with Katuunko for the Toydarian's refusal of allegiance during the Rugosa negotiations,{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode314.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Witches of the Mist}} and so planned to have his apprentice travel to Toydaria and kidnap the king in an attempt to force Toydaria to align with the Confederacy.{{SWE|characters|katuunko|King Katuunko}} Opress arrived on the planet and was confronted by a number of Toydarian guardsmen, but the Zabrak slew them all as he cut a path towards Katuunko's throne room. The king was informed by one of his protectors of Opress's approach, and ordered two guards to stop the intruder. As they moved towards the door, it was blasted inwards and killed them. As Katuunko watched in shocked horror, a demonic figure with a red double-bladed lightsaber emerged through the smoke and, although his royal guards attempted to kill the intruder, the Nightbrother slew them all before attempting to moving against Katuunko himself. Though displaying evident fear towards this assassin, the king refused to be intimidated by such brute force and drew his ceremonial Toydarian sword against his assailant. He managed to dodge one of Opress' strikes but his sword was easily destroyed by Opress's [[Double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|double-bladed]] [[Savage Opress's lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] when he attempted to fight back. Knowing he could not stand against the Zabrak, Katuunko attempted to fly away, but his leg was seized by Opress and he was thrown against a wall. With the Toydarian rendered unconscious, Opress slung him over his shoulder and attempted to make his way out, but was intercepted by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], who had been hunting for the apprentice. Savage [[Showdown at Toydaria/Legends|engaged]] the two Jedi with the king still unconscious on his back, but was overwhelmed by the Jedi during their short but fierce duel. While Dooku's assassin was distracted, Katuunko awoke and attempted to flee, but was caught by Opress in a [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinetic]] Force choke-hold. Although Kenobi and Skywalker attempted to pin down the Zabrak and take him into custody, Opress held onto Katuunko, eventually crushing his throat and killing him. Katuunko's body fell to the floor of his throne room before it was grabbed by Opress and dragged out of the palace during his escape from the Jedi. Savage ferried the king's body up to Count Dooku's [[Providence-class carrier/destroyer/Legends|Confederate destroyer]] in orbit, where he presented the deceased monarch to his Master. Dooku, who had hoped to force Katuunko to change his allegiance to the Confederacy, was furious with his apprentice, as a dead Toydarian king was useless to him.{{CN|url=tv_shows/starwars/?episodeID=8a250ab02d76df84012db88c48d10427|text=Dataclip: Witches of the Mist|na=video file}} Katuunko's assassination ultimately resulted in a three-way [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duel]] between Dooku, Opress, and an avenging Asajj Ventress. ===Legacy=== Many of Toydaria's citizens became distrustful of all [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-users]] following Katuunko's assassination, and Toydaria ultimately withdrew from the Republic as a result. Katuunko's nephew [[Maalva]] succeeded him on the throne; he had a cantankerous and scheming nature in contrast to his uncle's mild temperament. At the end of the Clone Wars,''[[Lords of Nal Hutta]]'' Palpatine [[Declaration of a New Order|falsely accused]] the Jedi of betraying the Republic and attempting to seize power,{{Film|III}} seemingly validating the Toydarian's perspective. Following Palpatine's Declaration of a New Order, the Toydarian royal guard also formed an elite brigade dedicated to hunting down force-users. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|I will not deal with those who break their words.|King Katuunko, to Count Dooku|audio=Katuunko4.flac|}} Although his position as Toydarian king placed him as a servant of the Hutts, Katuunko did what he could to remain independent. He was also strongly compassionate and cared deeply for his world; he was willing to side with the Separatists if it meant keeping his people safe from the carnage of the Clone Wars,{{CN|url=tv_shows/starwars/?episodeID=8a2505961cbf3b30011cbfb2bfe30007|text=Dataclip: Ambush|na=video file}} but preferred neutrality above other options. He was shrewd enough to understand the lucrative position his world held for the Republic and Confederacy. The king also understood that this position put Toydaria under constant threat, and he would need an alliance with one of the major galactic powers in order to protect his people. Although Katuunko was preferential to the Republic and supported its humanitarian causes, he was skeptical of its intentions in Hutt Space and so was unwilling to blindly enter into a Republic treaty. Katuunko instead allowed for negotiations to take place; however, he insisted that military power was not to be used to force an agreement, and he refused to take part in negotiations at [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] point or with [[Warship/Legends|warships]] orbiting overhead. While the king was surprised with being greeted by Dooku and Ventress on Rugosa, he did not send them away, as he wished the best for his people and wanted to join whichever faction could offer Toydaria the best protection, whether it was the Confederacy or the Republic. Although Katuunko was displeased with the contest on Rugosa, he permitted it to take place, as he wished to see a show of force from both the Confederacy and Republic. [[File:Katuunko-WitchesOfTheMist.png|thumb|left|280px|Katuunko defends himself against Savage Opress.]] The Toydarian monarch exhibited a strong sense of humor, even in a serious situation such as the Mission on Rugosa. After seeing the carnage immediately following 224's report of Yoda's surrender, Katuunko commented, "That's a lot of smoke for a surrender." His curiosity and fascination with the Jedi allowed the Republic's mission to succeed, but his dedication to honesty and honor almost resulted in his death. After informing Count Dooku of his aversion to the Confederacy's tactics of deception and intimidation, he was nearly assassinated by Asajj Ventress. However, even with two [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] blades inches from his head, Katuunko remained undaunted. It was his bravery and dedication to honest competition on Rugosa that ultimately cost him his life—Count Dooku held a grudge against the monarch for his decision to side with the Jedi, and so sent his apprentice to capture him alive. When Opress arrived at Toydaria and began to cut a swath through the king's defenders, Katuunko chose not to flee immediately; instead, he remained on his throne up until the Zabrak moved against him personally and even informed the lightsaber-wielding assassin that he would not be intimidated by displays of brute force. The king drew his ceremonial Toydarian sword to defend himself, but ultimately to no avail. Katuunko was killed when he finally decided that escape was his only remaining option. ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|Poor King Katuunko, we barely knew him! Savage Opress makes short work of the Toydarian monarch, putting an end to Katuunko's string of recurring ''Clone Wars'' appearances.|''Star Wars Insider 125''|{{InsiderCite|125|50 Great Reasons to Rewatch Star Wars: The Clone Wars Season Three|50 Great Reasons to Rewatch ''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Season Three}}}} [[File:KatuunkoConcept-TCWs1BR1.png|thumb|right|250px|King Katuunko concept art]] Katuunko first appeared in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (webcomics)|online comic]] [[The Clone Wars: Prelude|''Prelude'']], which served as a preview for the first episode of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series on [[Cartoon Network]], "[[Ambush]]." The Toydarian monarch later returned to the series in the [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|season two]] episode "[[Senate Murders]]," although he had no speaking parts, and once again in the [[The Clone Wars: Season Three|third season]] episode, "[[Supply Lines]]." Katuunko played a major role in "Supply Lines," which served as a prelude to [[The Clone Wars: Season One|season one's]] "Ambush." The king was again seen briefly in the episode "[[Pursuit of Peace]]," which served as a prelude for "Senate Murders." The Toydarian monarch was killed in "[[Witches of the Mist]]," the third and final chapter of Season Three's "Nightsister trilogy." In the episodes, Katuunko is voiced by [[Brian George]],{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode303.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Supply Lines}} who would return throughout the series to portray a number of other characters, including [[Pantoran/Legends|Pantoran]] [[Chairman/Legends|Chairman]] [[Chi Cho/Legends|Chi Cho]] in the episode "[[Trespass]]."{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode015.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Trespass}} Katuunko was designed to be clearly different visually than any other Toydarian in the ''[[Star Wars]]'' saga, particularly [[Watto/Legends|Watto]] from [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']]. The intentional variations included his large stomach, his unusual beard, and his rangefinder inspired by the [[Wikipedia:Flash Gordon|''Flash Gordon'' series]].[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars The
